topic.source_contract: Scheduled-monument designation, archaeological significance, consent, evaluation, written schemes, fieldwork and archive evidence

facts.consent: written Scheduled Monument Consent is required before most works
facts.guard: planning permission does not replace SMC

facts.survey: Section 42 consent can be required for metal-detecting and geophysical equipment on scheduled monuments
facts.guard: survey consent is not works consent

facts.policy: scheduled monuments are designated assets of the highest significance

facts.designation: scheduling protects nationally important archaeological sites
facts.guard: map proximity is not exact boundary confirmation

facts.planning: proportionate archaeological assessment, evaluation and mitigation
facts.guard: desk assessment is not site clearance

scope_guards: Planning permission is not treated as Scheduled Monument Consent.
A designation map is not treated as a surveyed exact monument boundary.
A desk-based assessment is not treated as absence of archaeology.
Geophysical survey is not treated as complete evaluation or excavation.
Section 42 survey consent is not treated as consent for works.
An agreed WSI is not treated as completed and accepted fieldwork.
Preservation by record is not treated as automatic justification for harm.
No score or promotion is written without exact asset, significance, consent, fieldwork, reporting, archive and condition-discharge evidence.
